title: Press kit page
what: A press kit page for a game or product: key art band, title and tagline, fact sheet column with 5 facts and 3 links, description, 5 features, a grid of 4 screenshots, logo and icon box, press contact.

slots.TITLE: Saltmarsh Courier
slots.TAGLINE: A quiet delivery game about a boat, a marsh town and the tide.
slots.FACT_1_VALUE: Two Herons Studio, a team of two
slots.ABOUT_1: Saltmarsh Courier is a quiet delivery game set in a flooded marsh town. You steer a flat-bottomed boat through reed channels and carry letters, seedlings and the odd goat between stilt houses before the tide turns.
slots.ABOUT_2: There is no timer and no way to fail. The tide table is the only clock: channels open and close through the day, so every route is a small puzzle you solve by reading the water.
slots.FEATURE_1: A hand-drawn marsh that changes with the tide table
slots.FEATURE_2: 40 deliveries, each a short story about a neighbour
slots.FEATURE_3: No combat, no timers, no way to fail
slots.FEATURE_4: Play with keyboard, mouse or gamepad
slots.FEATURE_5: Six to eight hours for a first playthrough
slots.SHOTS_NOTE: All images may be used in articles and videos about the game.
slots.LOGO_NOTE: PNG and SVG files for light and dark backgrounds are in the asset pack.
slots.CONTACT_NOTE: We answer press mail within two working days. Review keys are available on request.
slots.FOOT_NOTE: © 2026 Two Herons Studio. This page and its images are free to use for coverage.
